name: p7-inputs
caption: What was entered in the app for each case.
markdown:
| module   | area                          | what was entered                                                                                                          |
|:---------|:------------------------------|:--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| Banjir   | Kabupaten Demak               | before 1-29 Feb 2024, after 14-24 Mar 2024; descending orbit; DEM FABDEM; HAND limit 15 m (all defaults except the dates) |
| Api      | Kabupaten Ogan Komering Ilir  | before 1 Jun-31 Jul 2023, after 15 Oct-30 Nov 2023                                                                        |
| Rawan    | Provinsi Jawa Barat           | hazard Longsor, year 2024, DEM SRTM, 120 trees; trained automatically from the NASA landslide catalogue                   |
| Ubah     | Kabupaten Penajam Paser Utara | index difference, NDVI, 2019 against 2024, threshold 0.2                                                                  |
